resume: Where to look for a place in Réunion, which documents to prepare for the daycare (crèche) application, and how to get help from the Caf (CMG) when you employ a registered childminder (assistante maternelle).
aQuoiCaSert: Having your young child looked after lets you work, look for a job or train. Daycare (crèche) places are scarce and should be requested early, often during pregnancy. If you directly employ a registered childminder (assistante maternelle agréée), the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) can pay the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) and cover the social security contributions. Having a complete file from your very first request avoids losing your place on a waiting list.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of a child under 6, or under 12 for a single parent, for the CMG.

As a general rule, the parent or both parents must work to receive the CMG. Treated as work: sick leave, maternity or paternity leave, paid training, paid unemployment. No work requirement for students, recipients of the AAH (adult disability allowance), and some recipients of the RSA (minimum income) or the ASS (solidarity allowance for job seekers).
aSavoir: Municipal daycare: the application form is usually obtained from the town hall (mairie). Non-profit or private daycare: you apply to the facility's management. Look into it during pregnancy.

Childminders are registered (agréées) by the PMI (protection maternelle et infantile, the mother and child health service) of the Département de La Réunion. By employing them directly, you become their employer and sign an employment contract.

CMG for direct employment: the amount depends on your monthly income, the number of children, the hourly cost of childcare (capped) and the number of hours. Social security contributions are covered 100% for a registered childminder, up to a monthly ceiling.
The CMG can be paid from the month before the application if the conditions are met. Families who were already receiving it on August 31, 2025 did not have to apply again.
Shared residence: since December 1, 2025, each of the two parents can receive the CMG, calculated according to their own situation. It is not a split: the amounts may differ.
You must register on Pajemploi and declare the salary there each month. Pajemploi calculates and pays the CMG; the Pajemploi+ option also handles paying the salary.
As a rule, the CMG cannot be combined with the additional birth leave (congé supplémentaire de naissance) for the same child (with exceptions for some children born in the first half of 2026).

documents.libelle: Family record book (livret de famille) or the child's birth certificate
documents.detail: Copy. During pregnancy, a certificate of pregnancy is often requested instead. Birth certificate free on service-public.gouv.fr.
Copy. Municipal daycares often reserve places for residents of the town.

documents.libelle: Latest tax notice or Caf beneficiary number
documents.detail: Copy. Used to calculate the daycare's fee.
Employment contract, payslips, certificate of training or from France Travail (the public employment service), depending on the case.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting residence and parental authority, if you are separated
documents.detail: Copy. Shows who may pick up the child and each parent's weeks.

documents.libelle: Vaccination pages of the health record book (carnet de santé)
documents.detail: Copy. The compulsory vaccines for the child's year of birth are required to start daycare.

documents.libelle: The child's Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance) certificate of entitlement
The childminder's employment contract and certificate of registration
documents.detail: Original signed by both parties. Ask for a copy of the registration issued by the PMI.
For the daycare's direct debit or the payment of the CMG.

etapes.titre: Look for childcare options near you
etapes.detail: On monenfant.fr, through a relais petite enfance (RPE, early childhood information center) or at the town hall.

Family record book or certificate of pregnancy, parents' ID, proof of address, tax notice or Caf number, proof of activity, judgment if you are separated, vaccination pages. Phone the daycare to ask for its exact list.
At the town hall for a municipal daycare, otherwise with the management. Note the date you applied and follow up regularly.

etapes.titre: With a childminder, check their registration and sign the contract
etapes.detail: Registration is issued by the PMI of the Département de La Réunion.
With the Caf de La Réunion, in your online account. Not yet a beneficiary? First create your account. Then register as an employer on Pajemploi and declare the salary each month.
In the Journal, to track the expense per child and the split with the other parent.
